summary: Checked bigInteger, isValidByte/Short/Char/Int, isWhole, and underlying against their bodies; all are factually accurate (isValidX checks are correct given _long==Long.MinValue tags non-long-encoded values out of every checked range, verified via the class's encoding invariant comment). Two nits: a redundant duplicate @deprecated tag on isWhole, and an unnecessary two-line split for the four one-sentence isValidX comments.

items.issue: The doc comment repeats the @deprecated annotation's message as an @deprecated tag inside the comment body, which is pure duplication of information Scaladoc already renders from the annotation above (and no other @deprecated member in this file/comparable stdlib files duplicates the tag this way, e.g. TrieMap.lookup and LinkedHashMap.LinkedKeySet do not).
items.suggestion: Drop the @deprecated tag from inside the comment; keep just the one-sentence description.

items.issue: Applies to all 4 occurrences (lines 291, 294, 297, 300): each single-sentence doc is split across two lines with the closing */ alone on its own line, inconsistent with other one-sentence comments in the same file that stay on one line (e.g. line 276 'Returns the hash code for this BigInt.', line 345 'underlying').
items.suggestion: Collapse each to a single line: `/** Returns \`true\` if this \`BigInt\` can be represented as a \`Byte\`, \`false\` otherwise. */`
